rationale: I authorize the version-only amendment to bce-engine-architecture@0.1.1 as the repository solo steward. All 47 constraints, severities, scope, intent references, and approval requirements remain unchanged, and the real source proof kills all 47 mutants. Enforcement remains enabled. This decision is self-ratified; independent review and product efficacy are not claimed. The coding agent executes this recorded transition under my authorization.

I accept this exact policy as its solo steward. The amendment to bce-engine-architecture@0.1.2 brings the src/stack/ plane under the engine's own contract. That plane was added by #89 and has since grown through #92 (pnpm lockfile reader), #91 (stack diff) and #93 (release carry-ins); all four of its files are on main at 996db96c. The amendment adds one glob never-exit row, widens both extraction-seam scopes to the plane, adds a no-network/no-subprocess import row and a row forbidding the global network APIs, and raises the scan floor to 45, the real recursive src/**/*.ts count on the merged tree. All seven semantic-diff rows are classified tightening; no constraint, severity, scope or approval requirement is removed or loosened.

This review supersedes steward review 5254884863, which was bound to head dd130a1 against an older base and is stale. The packet was re-prepared once, at head a126e0905b8e2e300adccd2da1060c2f80780d47, after #91 and #93 landed, so it describes the final base. Findings from the first review were fixed in dd130a1 and still hold: the no-network row matches every import form with or without the node: prefix, and the minFiles SYNC test is a range (above the flat count, at most the recursive count), so a future file in the plane inherits coverage without forcing an amendment.

Proof on a throwaway copy with the candidate installed as the engine blueprint: extractor-real teeth 50/50, clean run 100. A planted fetch(), `import 'net'`, import('node:dns/promises'), require('child_process') and process.exit each turn the run red, while a node:crypto import stays green. A planted fetch() and a planted process.exit are each caught in every one of the four src/stack files (stack-manifest, stack-extractor, stack-diff, pnpm-lock-reader), and the clean tree scores 100 before and after. The full suite is 1336 tests, equal to the badge, and the live .blueprints/engine.blueprint.json on this branch is byte-identical to main until the amend step runs.

This decision is self-ratified. It was reviewed, posted and executed by the coding agent under the steward's recorded delegation, quoted verbatim: "Delegate: I (agent) run the amend ceremony as steward for these 3 PRs". This PR is the policy-coverage half of the first of those three amendments, split out because an engine-code PR cannot carry a blueprint change. Independent review, independent replication and product efficacy are not claimed.
